title: National Digital Accessibility Policy
authority: UAE Telecommunications and Digital Government Regulatory Authority
notes: National policy covers UAE government digital services and specified service providers and contractors. Official technical annex references WCAG 2.1 Level AA for public service sites. Formal legal enforceability, detailed exceptions and effective dates require qualified review.
scope: Federal government digital services and parties covered by policy

title: Guideline for Web Accessibility of Government Websites, v1.0
notes: Government web accessibility guideline. Saudi national portal separately states WCAG 2.1 AA for government websites and digital services. This record must not conflate a guideline, a portal assertion, and a binding legal obligation.
standard: WCAG 2.1 AA (national portal assertion; confirm against governing instruments)

title: Qatar eAccessibility Policy (2011)
authority: Qatar Ministry of Communications and Information Technology (historical publisher: ictQATAR)
notes: Section 5.3.1.1 references WCAG 2.0 Level AA for public-sector websites. Check legal continuity and replacement status with MCIT before relying on it for a current compliance determination.
scope: Public-sector websites providing services and information to the public

title: Upcoming National ICT Accessibility Policy, v2.0.1 (2025)
authority: Qatar Ministry of Communications and Information Technology
source_title: Upcoming National ICT Accessibility Policy v2.0.1
notes: Document explicitly identifies itself as upcoming; references WCAG 2.2 AAA where possible/applicable. DO NOT classify as enacted or enforceable until formally confirmed, with adoption and effective dates.

title: UAE Ministry of Education Digital Accessibility Policy
source_title: UAE Ministry of Education Digital Accessibility Policy
notes: Agency states minimum WCAG 2.1 and 2.2 Level AA, describes audits and feedback, and acknowledges legacy-content limitations. Its statement is not an independent audit or a general requirement on every UAE organization.

title: UAE Ministry of Finance Digital Accessibility Policy
source_title: UAE Ministry of Finance Digital Accessibility Policy
notes: Ministry policy cites national policy and WCAG, commits to periodic reviews and provides feedback channels. Version-specific conformance cannot be derived from this source alone.
standard: WCAG (version and level not specified on this page)

title: Saudi Ministry of Economy and Planning Accessibility Policy
authority: Saudi Ministry of Economy and Planning
source_title: Saudi Ministry of Economy and Planning Accessibility Policy
notes: Fourteen-clause agency policy addresses WCAG 2.1, scope, monitoring, assistive technologies, forms, and periodic review. Multiple qualifiers mean a Boolean compliance determination is not supported without interpretation.
scope: Ministry website, platforms and digital content

title: Loi n° 18-07 du 10 juin 2018 relative à la protection des personnes physiques dans le traitement des données à caractère personnel
authority: République Algérienne Démocratique et Populaire — Journal Officiel
source_title: Journal officiel n° 34 du 10 juin 2018 — Loi n° 18-07
notes: Le Journal officiel n° 34 publie la loi n° 18-07. Une loi modificative n° 25-11 de 2025 est signalée sur le même portail ; le texte consolidé, l’entrée en vigueur et les dispositions transitoires n’ont pas été vérifiés. Cette fiche est un prototype non autoritatif.
scope: Traitement de données à caractère personnel par des organismes publics ou des personnes privées, dans les conditions prévues par la loi.

title: Personal Data Protection Law No. 24 of 2023
authority: Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan — Ministry of Digital Economy and Entrepreneurship (official English translation)
source_title: Personal Data Protection Law No. (24) of 2023 — official English translation
notes: The captured PDF is an official English translation with the Arabic text alongside it. Article 1 provides for commencement six months after publication in the Official Gazette; the publication date and resulting commencement date were not established from this copy. This is a prototype record, not an authoritative statement of Jordanian law.
scope: Processing of personal data by controllers and processors, subject to the exclusions and conditions in the Law.

title: Loi n° 09-08 relative à la protection des personnes physiques à l'égard du traitement des données à caractère personnel
authority: Royaume du Maroc — Ministère de la Transition Numérique et de la Réforme de l'Administration (Banque de Données Juridiques)
source_title: Loi n° 09-08 promulguée par le dahir n° 1-09-15 du 22 safar 1430 (18 février 2009)
notes: La Banque de données juridiques publie le texte français et indique une publication au Bulletin officiel n° 5711 du 23 février 2009. La version faisant foi, le décret d’application et les modifications éventuelles n’ont pas été vérifiés. Cette fiche est un prototype non autoritatif.
scope: Traitement de données à caractère personnel par des responsables établis au Maroc ou recourant à des moyens situés au Maroc, sous réserve des exclusions prévues.
